stories.title: Brazil votes in a tight first-round presidential election between Lula and Flavio Bolsonaro
stories.reason: Polls show the incumbent and Senator Flavio Bolsonaro in a virtual tie for Latin America's largest democracy, with a runoff on October 25 likely if neither wins a majority outright, in a vote shadowed by corruption concerns and US-China rivalry over Brazil's economy.

stories.title: G7 nations agree to release 100 million barrels of oil and diesel to curb soaring fuel prices
stories.reason: The release, front-loaded with diesel within 20 days after US pressure on Europe, comes as fuel prices hit records and the G7 also pledged not to impose export restrictions on energy products amid the ongoing Middle East conflict's pressure on markets.

stories.title: Trump announces one-time $90 Medicare payments for more than 20 million seniors
stories.reason: Funded through the Medicare Improvement Fund, the payments aim to offset Part B premiums ahead of November's midterms, though they exclude enrollees whose premiums are already paid by Medicaid or who pay income-related surcharges.

stories.title: Gunmen kidnap 20 NYSC corps members in Nigeria, demand nearly $600,000 in ransom
stories.reason: The graduates were abducted from buses along the Owerri-Onitsha Road while traveling to orientation camps, and police say 10 have been rescued so far as a senior officer leads the search for the rest amid a ₦950 million ransom demand.

stories.title: Malaysia repatriates nearly 1,500 Myanmar migrants despite UN safety warnings
stories.reason: The group is the first of 5,000 Myanmar nationals Kuala Lumpur plans to send back under a deal it calls voluntary, but the UN says conditions in Myanmar's ongoing civil war mean safe return cannot be guaranteed, with fears some returnees could be conscripted.

stories.title: Iran executes a man detained during January's anti-government protests
stories.reason: The judiciary accused Siavash Jamshidi Kheirabadi of firing on police during the unrest that erupted over economic hardship and swelled into calls to end clerical rule, with Tehran again blaming foreign-backed operatives for the violence.

stories.title: Apple Pay launches in India, starting with Axis Bank credit cards
stories.reason: The service arrives in one of the world's biggest smartphone markets after years on the sidelines, though it launches without UPI or RuPay support and with HDFC, ICICI and SBI Card still negotiating terms to join.

stories.title: Meta expands its Muse AI agent to 200 million small businesses on its platform
stories.reason: Muse for Small Business connects to QuickBooks, Shopify, Stripe and other tools to automate customer messaging, cash flow and marketing, with analysts estimating the push could generate billions in subscription revenue if adoption follows Meta's consumer rollout.
